data.why: The repo already ships a ready-made directory-of-directories (nerv_data/compass-nd, nerv_data/prevent-AD) in exactly the layout app.start() expects, so the server can point at it directly without any wrapper script constructing folders.

goals: pick a dataset (compass-nd or prevent-AD) and see which pipelines/pass-fail outcomes diverge across continuous-testing runs
compare two pipeline outputs against each other on a scatter plot to spot systematic disagreement between pipelines
inspect the histogram of a single metric to find outlier subjects whose pipeline output is anomalous
click an individual point/bar to pull up the underlying subject/session metadata behind a suspicious result
switch the UI theme/settings to check the plots remain legible for a report or presentation

review.summary: The tree captures NeRV's purpose well: compare one measurement across pipelines with a distribution view and a pairwise joint plot, then trace odd or failed results to their per-step processing records. The screens I checked mostly support it. It needs small fixes before filing: it wrongly says the axis dropdowns are mutually exclusive, the paired-record task overstates that both records are for the same subject, and one action is attached to the wrong subject.
